story: Palantir could be the most overvalued company that ever existed
text: I'll throw the British South Sea Trading Company into the ring for that title of most overvalued company ever. It had the king himself on the board. The company value represented a decent fraction of the national gdp at the time. All without actually never producing anything of actual value. It was just bribes and speculation all the way through. It's wild. [LINK] Extra History did a more easily digestible series, which was how I learned about it in the first place. [VIDEO]
